title: micro:bit blocks reference
summary: The blocks from micro:bit Foundations, each with what it does. Find them in the MakeCode toolbox; the picture shows the block, the code is the same block as MakeCode JavaScript.

items.label: show icon
items.hint: Shows a ready-made picture. Basic › show icon; click the picture to choose another.

items.label: show leds
items.hint: Draw your own picture: click squares to light them (# is on). Basic › show leds.

items.label: show string
items.hint: Scrolls a word or message across the screen. Basic › show string.

items.label: show number
items.hint: Shows a number; numbers above 9 scroll. Basic › show number.

items.label: show arrow
items.hint: Shows an arrow pointing a direction. Basic › more › show arrow.

items.label: clear screen
items.hint: Turns every LED off. Basic › more › clear screen.

items.label: pause
items.hint: Waits before the next block. 1000 ms is one second. Basic › pause.

items.label: forever
items.hint: Runs the blocks inside again and again. Blocks in on start run only once.

items.label: on button pressed
items.hint: Runs the blocks inside every time the button is pressed. Choose A, B or A+B. Input.

items.label: on shake
items.hint: Runs the blocks inside every time the micro:bit is shaken (or tilted, if you choose another gesture). Input.

items.label: set variable
items.hint: Puts a value in a variable, throwing the old value away. Make the variable in Variables first.

items.label: change variable
items.hint: Adds to a variable's value. Change by -1 counts down. Variables.

items.label: light level
items.hint: How bright it is: 0 (dark) to 255 (bright). Input.

items.label: temperature
items.hint: How warm it is, in degrees Celsius. Input.

items.label: acceleration
items.hint: Tilt: x is left (below 0) and right (above 0), y is forward and back. Input › more.

items.label: plot bar graph
items.hint: Lights more LEDs for a bigger value. The second number is the biggest value. Led.

items.label: if
items.hint: Runs the blocks inside only when the condition is true; does nothing when it is false. Logic.

items.label: if else
items.hint: Exactly one part runs: the first when the condition is true, else the second. Click + on an if block.

items.label: else if
items.hint: Another question, asked only if the ones above were false. The first true one wins.

items.label: list
items.hint: Many values in order under one name. Places start at 0. Advanced › Arrays.

items.label: get value at
items.hint: The item at a place in the list, counted from 0. Arrays.

items.label: length of list
items.hint: How many items are in the list. The last place is the length − 1. Arrays.

items.label: pick random
items.hint: A random whole number from the first to the second, both included. Math.

items.label: function
items.hint: A named job. Making it does not run it: a call block runs it. Advanced › Functions.

items.label: function with a parameter
items.hint: A function with an input. Call it with a value: showScore(5). Functions › Add a parameter.

items.label: radio set group
items.hint: Picks a channel (0 to 255). Only micro:bits in the same group hear each other. Radio.

items.label: radio send number
items.hint: Sends a number to every other micro:bit in the group. Radio.

items.label: on radio received
items.hint: Runs each time a number arrives; receivedNumber holds it. Radio.

items.label: radio send string
items.hint: Sends a word to every other micro:bit in the group. Radio.

items.label: on radio received string
items.hint: Runs each time a word arrives; receivedString holds it. Radio.

items.label: running time
items.hint: Milliseconds since the micro:bit switched on. Take one from a later one to time something. Input › more.

items.label: true or false
items.hint: A variable can hold true or false, to remember what is happening now. Logic.

items.label: serial write value
items.hint: Sends a line such as light:128 down the USB cable. The board graphs it; MakeCode's simulator shows it under Show data. Serial.

items.label: serial write line
items.hint: Sends a line of text down the USB cable. Serial.

items.label: on serial data received
items.hint: Runs each time a whole line arrives over USB (it ends with a new line). Serial.

items.label: serial read line
items.hint: The line that arrived, as text, without its new line. Use it inside on serial data received. Serial.

items.label: radio send value
items.hint: Sends a name and a number by radio, such as bin and 1. Radio.

items.label: on radio received value
items.hint: Runs each time a name and number arrive by radio. Radio.

items.label: servo write pin
items.hint: Turns a servo on that pin to an angle from 0 to 180 (90 is the middle). Pins.
